item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Nitya looks at the diagram of polygon $PQRS$ on square-grid paper. Sides $PQ$ and $QR$ run along the grid lines. Side $PS$ cuts diagonally across grid squares.

Which claim about the boundary length is correct?

options.A: Call the answer grid path only, with one shared length label for every side.
options.B: Count the diagonal side $PS$ as $1$ grid unit, the same as a straight grid side.
options.C: Measure the straight sides in grid units and treat diagonal side $PS$ as longer than one straight grid unit, then add those lengths.
options.D: Say that calling the diagonal longer is what creates polygon $PQRS$ on the grid.
